profile.application: First-stage transport shortlist for a nonaqueous polymer electrolyte in lithium-metal cells operated at 30 C
profile.origin: Analyst-selected research demonstration after exploratory source reading; not a universal electrolyte threshold, industrial standard or blinded benchmark. Fixed before the independent reference and selector replay on 2026-10-27.
profile.decision_scope: Keep means advance to battery-specific follow-up after this one conductivity check. It does not establish complete battery suitability, practical safety, salted-film healing or device qualification. No ranking across papers or unlike geometries.
profile.eligibility_note: The role, chemistry, formulation and comparator status are reviewed research inputs, not automatically validated by the numeric selector. The PTMG-HDI/LiFSI control is explicitly a performance control, not independently established here as a dynamic-polymer candidate.
protocol_notes: SS denotes the source's blocking steel electrodes. Pei explicitly defines SS as sheet steel. Do not silently expand every SS abbreviation to stainless steel.

Preserve assembly, resistance definition, thickness, salt, residual solvent/plasticizer and frequency range in the observation. This broad entry screen accepts the authors' reported conductivity from SS/electrolyte/SS; it does not assert identical bulk/interface separation or geometry across papers.
No interpolation from 25/35 C, substitution from 60 C, or assignment of an unspecified room temperature to 30 C.
A plotted 30 C point without an exact extracted value remains incomplete; declared figure digitization or raw-data retrieval is a follow-up, not an exact reported measurement.
Do not convert a neat-polymer healing result into a salted-electrolyte result or transfer a wet/plasticized result to a dry matrix.
outside_entry_screen: Exact-salted-formulation healing mechanism, temperature, time and recovered property
Lithium compatibility and cycling at selected current density, areal capacity, temperature and pressure
Oxidative stability and lithium-ion transference number under specified protocols
Full-cell cathode, loading, electrolyte amount, voltage window and rate definition
Mechanical durability, residual solvent, reproducibility and practical safety

pei-bhds-transport.locator: Main Electrochemical characterization of the SPEs, first paragraph (XML Sec5/Par13), Fig3a/b
pei-bhds-transport.context_review: Exact BHDS/LiFSI sample; reported 30 C conductivity. Preparation Par27 establishes polymer:LiFSI mass2:1. Methods Par30/31: SS sandwich EIS0.1–10^6 Hz, default30 C, sigma=L/(R*S), R=total electrolyte resistance. BHDS dual-integrated assembly has about200 micrometre total bonded thickness; identical comparator assembly is not established.

pei-hdi-transport.context_review: Current-work PTMG-HDI/LiFSI comparator, polymer:LiFSI mass2:1. Reported30 C conductivity with general SS/EIS method. Do not copy BHDS dual-integrated200 micrometre geometry to this sample; no independent dynamic-polymer eligibility claim for control.

pei-temperature.context_review: Temperature applies to the conductivity comparison, not a healing treatment.

cao-transport.locator: Main sec7 Electrochemical properties, Fig8a and following paragraph
cao-transport.context_review: Ordered list assigns this number to ShSPE-3, not ShSP-3 or samples1/2. EO/Li=16:1; SS/ShSPE/SS EIS20–80 C. Explicit60 C number is related evidence, never a30 C value.

cao-30C-plot.locator: Supplement PDF p8 FigS3; synthesis pp2–3; EIS pp4–5
cao-30C-plot.transcription: Manually transcribed figure-legend temperature; not a numeric conductivity transcription

chen-series.locator: Main section3.3, Fig6a and temperature-ordered values; FigS2
chen-series.context_review: First two values in ordered series are25 and35 C, unitS·cm−1 given later in original sentence. No30 C numeric entry. SS discs; sigma=l/(R*A), bulk resistance. SHPEM12 micrometre in Methods vs about15 micrometre in Results; EIS method says with liquid electrolyte. Do not assert dry state or interpolate.

chen-wetted.locator: Main section3.3, wet-membrane comparison; section2.5 cell preparation and section2.6 EIS
chen-wetted.context_review: Separate10 microlitre-liquid-electrolyte membrane comparison. Room temperature has no exact Celsius value here. Do not equate with30 C or unplasticized matrix; EC:DMC1:1 added to cell in Methods.
